cards.front: ¡Échale un vistazo a esto!
cards.back: Take a look at this!

cards.front: ¿Has echado ya un vistazo a ese e-mail que te envié?
cards.back: Have you had a look at that email I sent you yet?

cards.front: ¿Estás loco? ¡No voy a decir a mi médico que eche un vistazo a esto!
cards.back: Are you crazy? I'm not going to tell my doctor to take a look at this!

cards.front: Mira detenidamente esta foto; ¿reconoces a alguien en ella?
cards.back: Have a good look at this photo; do you recognize anyone in it?

cards.front: ¿Puedes echar una ojeada a este discurso que he escrito?
cards.back: Can you have a quick look at this speech I've written?

cards.front: Mirad bien estos billetes; ¿creéis que son falsos?
cards.back: Take a closer look at these notes; do you think they're fakes?

cards.front: Examínate a ti mismo detenidamente y reflexiona sobre lo que has hecho.
cards.back: Take a long hard look at yourself and think about what you've done.

cards.front: Tenemos que examinar detenidamente las leyes respecto a la regulación de los bancos.
cards.back: We need to take a long hard look at the laws concerning bank regulation.

cards.front: Debemos examinar detenidamente de qué manera tratamos el tema del absentismo en esta empresa.
cards.back: We should take a long hard look at the way we deal with absenteeism in this company.

cards.front: Ella me lanzó una mirada inexpresiva cuando se lo pregunté.
cards.back: She gave me a blank look when I asked her about it.

cards.front: Tenías que haber visto la mirada asesina que me echó.
cards.back: You should have seen the dirty look he gave me!

cards.front: ¿Estás enfadada conmigo o te pasa algo? No dejas de mirarme de forma extraña.
cards.back: Are you angry with me or something? You keep giving me these strange looks.

cards.front: ¡Déjame verlo!
cards.back: Let's have a butcher's!

cards.front: ¿Le has echado un vistazo a esto?
cards.back: Have you had a butcher's at this?

cards.front: No, no te voy a dejar echar un vistazo.
cards.back: No, I'm not going to let you have a butcher's.

cards.front: No tienes ninguna posibilidad; ella sólo sale con los hombres guapos.
cards.back: You've got no chance; she only goes out with good-looking men.

cards.front: Son una pareja mona, ¿verdad?
cards.back: They make a good-looking couple, don't they?

cards.front: El director de casting le dijo que no era lo suficientemente guapo para el papel.
cards.back: The casting director told him that he wasn't good-looking enough for the part.

cards.front: Hay un insecto raro en tu espalda.
cards.back: There's a strange-looking insect on your back.

cards.front: El presidente resultó ser un hombre de aspecto raro con un traje naranja.
cards.back: The president turned out to be a strange-looking man in an orange suit.

cards.front: Nos dieron un plato con sesos de cabra que tenía una pinta rara.
cards.back: They gave us a strange-looking dish made from goat's brains.

cards.front: Puedes encontrar mucha gente con pintas raras en ese vecindario.
cards.back: You can find lots of funny-looking people in that neighborhood.

cards.front: ¡Qué sombrero más raro llevas!
cards.back: What a funny-looking hat you've got on!

cards.front: Los anfitriones dieron a todo el mundo unas gafas muy raras para que se las pusieran.
cards.back: The hosts gave everybody funny-looking glasses to wear.

cards.front: Recuerdo haber visto un tipo sospechoso leyendo el periódico en el rincón.
cards.back: I remember seeing a suspicious-looking character reading a paper in the corner.

cards.front: Hay un hombre sospechoso delante del banco.
cards.back: There's a suspicious-looking man standing outside the bank.

cards.front: ¿Hay algún sospechoso donde estás ahora?
cards.back: Are there any suspicious-looking people where you are now?

cards.front: La novia llevaba un vestido impresionante.
cards.back: The bride was wearing an amazing-looking dress.

cards.front: Vimos algunos yates impresionantes en el puerto.
cards.back: We saw some amazing-looking yachts in the harbour.

cards.front: ¿Dónde compró ella esos pendientes tan impresionantes?
cards.back: Where did she buy those amazing-looking earrings?

cards.front: Sé que eres más alta que yo; pero eso no es motivo para que me mires por encima del hombro.
cards.back: I know you're taller than me; but that's no reason to act like you're looking down your nose at me.

cards.front: ¿No te da la sensación de que él desprecia a todo el mundo?
cards.back: Doesn't he give you the feeling that he looks down on everyone?

cards.front: Él es un tonto sexista; siempre ha menospreciado a las mujeres.
cards.back: He's a sexist fool; he's always looked down on women.

cards.front: ¿Qué artistas admirabas cuando eras pequeño?
cards.back: What artists did you look up to as a kid?

cards.front: Tienes que dar un buen ejemplo; ellos te admiran de verdad.
cards.back: You have to set a good example; they really look up to you.

cards.front: ¿A quién admiras?
cards.back: Who do you look up to?

cards.front: De nada vale llorar sobre la leche derramada; tienes que mirar hacia adelante.
cards.back: You can't cry over spilt milk; you need to look ahead.

cards.front: Deja de buscar los CDs; tienes que mirar hacia delante cuando conduces.
cards.back: Stop looking for CDs; you need to look ahead when you're driving.

cards.front: Ya estamos haciendo los proyectos para el último trimestre.
cards.back: We're looking ahead now to the final quarter.

cards.front: Desde entonces él no ha vuelto a mirar hacia atrás.
cards.back: Ever since then, he has never looked back.

cards.front: Mirando atrás, qué tiempos fantásticos fueron aquellos.
cards.back: Looking back, those were fantastic times.

cards.front: No mires atrás con ira, te oí decir.
cards.back: Don't look back in anger, I heard you say.

cards.front: Ten cuidado con los carteristas cuando viajas en Metro aquí.
cards.back: Look out for pickpockets when you travel on the underground here.

cards.front: Esté atento al cameo de Hitchcock en esta película.
cards.back: Look out for Hitchcock's cameo in this film.

cards.front: Cuidaos el uno al otro mientras estáis viajando.
cards.back: Look out for each other while you're travelling.

cards.front: Ella le miró fijamente con incredulidad cuando él le contó la noticia.
cards.back: She gazed at him in disbelief when he told her the news.

cards.front: ¿Estás mirando algo de verdad o estás mirando al vacío?
cards.back: Are you actually looking at something or are you just gazing into space?

cards.front: Están tan enamorados que pasan todo el tiempo mirándose fijamente a los ojos.
cards.back: They're so in love that they just gaze into each other's eyes all the time.

cards.front: ¿Por qué te has quedado boquiabierto?
cards.back: What are you gaping at?

cards.front: Cierra la boca y deja de mirar así; ¿no sabes que es de mala educación mirar con la boca abierta?
cards.back: Close your mouth and stop looking like that; don't you know it's rude to gawk?

cards.front: No, él no es tonto; sólo es que suele quedarse boquiabierto cuando mira a la gente.
cards.back: No, he's not backward; he just tends to gawp when he looks at people.

cards.front: Ella no me contestó; se limitó a lanzarme una mirada feroz y silenciosa.
cards.back: She didn't answer; she just glared silently at me.

cards.front: Si alguna vez él te lanza una de sus feroces miradas, sabrás que estás metido en un buen lío.
cards.back: If he ever glares at you, you'll know you're in big trouble.

cards.front: No te estaba lanzando una mirada de odio; en realidad estaba mirando distraídamente al vacío.
cards.back: I wasn't glaring at you; I was actually gazing into space.

cards.front: Logré echar un vistazo a mi reloj sin que ella se diera cuenta.
cards.back: I managed to glance at my watch without her realizing.

cards.front: ¡Sin mirar a hurtadillas!
cards.back: No peeking!

cards.front: ¿Estabas echando una miradita al diario de Jenny?
cards.back: Were you peeping at Jenny's diary?

cards.front: ¡Deja de comerte con los ojos a todas las mujeres que entran en este bar!
cards.back: Can you stop ogling all the women who come into this bar?!

cards.front: Parece que él nunca me mira; siempre me da la impresión de que me está comiendo con los ojos.
cards.back: He never seems to look at me; I always feel like he's ogling me.

cards.front: Temo que me pillase (él) comiéndole con los ojos.
cards.back: I'm afraid he caught me ogling him.

cards.front: Me enamoré de ella la primera vez que le miré a los ojos.
cards.back: I fell in love with her the first time I looked into her eyes.

cards.front: Me miró a los ojos como si estuviera intentando descubrir mi alma.
cards.back: She looked into my eyes as if she was trying to find my soul.

cards.front: Le miré a los ojos y tuve la sensación de que ahí había un amigo en el que podía confiar.
cards.back: I looked into his eyes and had the feeling that here was a friend I could trust.

cards.front: Le miré directamente a los ojos y le conté exactamente lo que pensaba de él.
cards.back: I looked him straight in the eye and told him exactly what I thought of him.

cards.front: Mírame directamente a los ojos y dime que no estás mintiendo.
cards.back: Look me straight in the eye and tell me you're not lying.

cards.front: Ella le miró directamente a los ojos y le dijo que estaba teniendo una aventura.
cards.back: She looked him straight in the eye and told him that she was having an affair.

cards.front: Intenté empezar una conversación con ella, pero hizo como si no me viera.
cards.back: I tried to start a conversation with her, but she just looked straight through me.

cards.front: ¿No te da la sensación de que cuando hablas con él es como si no estuvieras allí?
cards.back: Don't you get the feeling that when you talk to him, he looks straight through you?

cards.front: Le saludamos (a ella), pero hizo como si no nos hubiera visto.
cards.back: We said hello to her, but she looked right through us.

cards.front: Yo nunca podría volver a mirarle (a ella) a la cara.
cards.back: I would never be able to look her in the face again.

cards.front: No sé cómo tienes la poca vergüenza de mirarle (a él) a la cara después de lo que le hiciste.
cards.back: I don't know how you can look him in the face after what you did to him.

cards.front: No sé qué le pasa (a ella), pero parece que se avergüenza cuando me ve últimamente.
cards.back: I don't know what's up with her, but lately she doesn't seem to be able to look me in the face.

cards.front: Cuando entré en su oficina (él) me miró de arriba abajo.
cards.back: When I entered his office he looked me up and down.

cards.front: ¿Por qué tienes que mirar a la gente de arriba abajo cuando les conoces?
cards.back: Why do you have to look people up and down when you meet them?

cards.front: Sí, creo que se puede llamar acoso sexual la manera que tiene de mirar a las mujeres de arriba abajo en el trabajo.
cards.back: Yes, I do think you could call it sexual harassment the way he looks women up and down in the workplace.

cards.front: Tengo muchas ganas de conocer al jefe nuevo.
cards.back: I'm really looking forward to meeting the new boss.

cards.front: A la espera de tener noticias suyas.
cards.back: I look forward to hearing from you.

cards.front: ¿Estáis esperando el examen final con ilusión?
cards.back: Are you looking forward to the final exam?

cards.front: ¡No hagas la vista gorda! ¡Haz algo!
cards.back: Don't look the other way! Do something!

cards.front: Él preferiría hacer la vista gorda antes que arriesgarse a tomar una decisión impopular.
cards.back: He'd rather look the other way than risk making an unpopular decision.

cards.front: Me sorprendió la cantidad de gente que hizo la vista gorda.
cards.back: I was surprised how many people looked the other way.

cards.front: Él empieza a aparentar la edad que tiene.
cards.back: He's beginning to look his age.

cards.front: ¿Has visto a Ron últimamente? Aparenta la edad que tiene, ¿verdad?
cards.back: Have you seen Ron recently? He's looking his age, isn't he?

cards.front: ¿Tienes 80 años? No aparentas la edad que tienes.
cards.back: You're eighty!? You don't look your age.

cards.front: Ahora que eres director, tienes que tener un aspecto serio.
cards.back: Now that you're a manager, you've got to look the part.

cards.front: Él aún no tiene un aspecto digno de su posición.
cards.back: He doesn't quite look the part yet.

cards.front: Si quieres el empleo, tienes que tener un aspecto digno del puesto.
cards.back: If you want the job, you have to look the part.

cards.front: Mira el lado bueno de las cosas; no cometerás el mismo error nunca más.
cards.back: Look on the bright side; you won't make the same mistake ever again.

cards.front: Mira el lado bueno; tuviste la oportunidad de practicar tu inglés.
cards.back: Look on the bright side; you got to practice your English.

cards.front: Mira el lado bueno; todo el mundo sabe quién eres ahora.
cards.back: Look on the bright side; everybody knows who you are now.
